title: Projection formula for the transpose of an ordered affine tower
statement:
Fix the finite-coefficient purity conventions [def-pur-conventions], so $k$ is the fixed algebraic closure of a finite field, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite with uniformizer $\varpi_E$, $n\geq1$ and $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Let $Y$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme, $p_m:X_m=\mathbf A^m_Y\to Y$ the projection, and $q_m:X_{m+1}\to X_m$ the last-coordinate affine-line projection [def-sbc-affine-space], with $p_{m+1}=p_mq_m$. Put $T_m=A_{X_m}(m)[2m]$ and $F_mK=Lp_m^*K\otimes_A^LT_m$, with twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Use ordinary finite constant-$A$ pro-etale derived categories and the constructible exceptional functors and their adjunction on bounded-below etale-origin inputs [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. For $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude] let $\Gamma_{m,K}$ be exactly the ordered comparison of [def-pur-affine-space-comparison], and define
$$\tau_{m,K}=\varepsilon_{p_m,K}\circ Rp_{m!}(\Gamma_{m,K}):Rp_{m!}F_mK\to K,\qquad I_m=\tau_{m,A_Y}.$$
Let $\Pi_{m,K}:Rp_{m!}F_mK\xrightarrow{\sim}K\otimes_A^LRp_{m!}T_m$ be the inverse canonical projection transformation [def-exchange-projection], with the same two tensor symmetries as in [def-pur-affine-line-purity-comparison]. Then the actual maps satisfy
$$\tau_{m,K}=(K\otimes I_m)\circ\Pi_{m,K}$$
with the tensor-unit constraint at the target, for every $m\geq0$; $I_0=1_{A_Y}$ and $I_1$ is the specified normalized affine-line integration. More precisely, for consecutive blocks $X\xrightarrow fZ\xrightarrow gY$, of respective lengths $a,b$, put $F_fM=Lf^*M(a)[2a]$ and define $\tau_f,\tau_g$ by the same ordered construction over their respective bases. The transpose of $c_{g,f}^{-1}\Gamma_{f,Rg^!K}F_f(\Gamma_{g,K})$ on $Rg_!Rf_!F_fF_gK$ is
$$\tau_{g,K}\circ Rg_!(\tau_{f,F_gK}).$$
All compact-support composition, source reassociation and pullback comparisons are the specified ones; no coordinate invariance or general ambient pro-etale adjoint is assumed.

proof.text: Compute the dimension-zero comparison, compact functor, counit and tateSourceIso: all are identities. Thus transpose_0 and integration_0 are identities and projection_0 is the coefficient right unitor. Its inverse followed by itself proves the coefficient formula at zero.

Induct on dimension with the hypothesis quantified over every finite-type base and retained etale origin. Apply the single successor calculation to the induction hypothesis. This proves the coefficient formula at all dimensions.
Use the line normalization lemma for integration_1. The zero normalization was computed directly.

For arbitrary blocks, use comparison naturality at v = eqToHom(hB);Gamma_b. Apply the compact-support functor and compose the exceptional counit. Counit naturality gives transpose naturality, including the identity at zero. Map this equality through compact_b and compose counit_b; functor.map_comp and associativity yield exactly BlockLaw.
